title: On algebraic dynamics of birational automorphisms of Calabi-Yau manifolds and the universal Coxeter groups
summary: This is a continuation of our study of algebraic dymanics of birational automorphisms of complex Calabi-Yau manifolds in the view of primitivity and the existence of Zariski dense orbit. The universal Coxeter groups and their Coxeter elements also play important roles in our study.
